call.target_note: the callee is not an FDE start, so no body size is claimed for it; it is the shared comparator also used by the min-cap gap-check window (#128) and the killed cmovbe family, but this window is not a family member (see README)

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

function.padding_note: five int3 bytes (0xcc) at [0x5430dab, 0x5430db0) pad the window to the next FDE at 0x5430db0 (the min-cap gap-check window of packet #128, excluded here)

edges.note: a_second < b_second returns 0 before any call; callee_result is meaningless here
a_second < b_second returns 0 even with a nonzero callee value, proving the fast path
b_second == 0 returns 1 without a call; callee_result is meaningless here
both seconds zero: b_second == 0 path returns 1, no call

rule.formula: if a_second < b_second (unsigned): return 0; if b_second == 0: return 1; offset = (a_first + (a_second - b_second)) mod 2**64; return 1 iff callee(offset, b_first, b_second) == 0, else 0
rule.formula_note: on the call path a_second >= b_second always holds (the a_second < b_second case returns early), so a_second - b_second is non-negative and the offset is a_first plus a non-negative difference, mod 2**64; the callee's third argument register rdx still holds b_second at the call
rule.inputs: a_first (u64 at input a + 0x00), a_second (u64 at input a + 0x08), b_first (u64 at input b + 0x00), b_second (u64 at input b + 0x08), callee_result (low 32 bits of eax from the call to 0x5660150 with (offset, b_first, b_second))
